AI Notes.value: Superunion launched Jan 2018 as a WPP merger of five consultancies: Brand Union, The Partners, Lambie-Nairn, Addison, and VBAT. Around 750 staff across 23 offices at peak, billing over $100m. Core capabilities: brand strategy, identity systems, motion graphics, packaging, corporate communications. Merged with Design Bridge in Jan 2023 to form Design Bridge and Partners (approx 850 staff, 12 countries); the Superunion brand was retired. Entry reflects the legacy Superunion entity; current operations sit under Design Bridge and Partners (designbridge.com). Size 100+ confirmed, WPP-owned agency. Country: multi-office per legacy record (UK HQ, US, Hong Kong). Work captured from Design Bridge and Partners' legacy Superunion case study pages (storage.googleapis.com/designbridge-3c80-uploads/su/), which host Superunion's work post-merger: ESL esports rebrand (2019), Notpla sustainable packaging identity (2021, Cannes Lions Grand Prix in Design), Shelter charity identity (2019), London Symphony Orchestra rebrand, and DreamHack gaming festival identity (2020). Superunion.com now 301-redirects to designbridge.com; Wayback Machine CDX was unavailable during this session. Instagram @superunionhq has been deleted (IG shows 'Profile isn't available'); not a throttle issue, the account was retired with the brand. No ig-queue needed.
